operator: South Caucasus Railway (Armenian Railways) / Georgian Railway overnight train
service: Overnight, departs Tbilisi 20:00, arrives Yerevan 06:35 (10 h 35 min); departs Yerevan 21:00, arrives Tbilisi 07:05

fare.text: Coupe / 2nd class (4-berth) GEL 147 / AMD 20,300; platzkart (open carriage, cheapest) GEL 115 / AMD 15,700 (about EUR 39.6); 2-berth lux GEL 218 / AMD 30,300 (Wander-Lush, winter 2026/27)

notes: IMPORTANT: winter timetable (2 Oct 2026 - 13 Jun 2027) runs every second day, departures from Tbilisi on odd dates and from Yerevan on even dates; Thu 10 Dec 2026 is an even date, so there is no Tbilisi departure that day - use 9 or 11 Dec. Fixed tariff, same in both directions; sales open 40 days ahead (11 Dec from about 1 Nov) at ticket.railway.am and gr.com.ge. Price comes from a travel blog quoting those portals; AMD price converts to about EUR 49.9. The platzkart is the budget option.
